title: The fund due-diligence & distribution pipeline
subtitle: At Conduit Group I turned raw alternative-asset fund PDFs into rated, documented shelf decisions — replacing manual triage for the investor-relations team.
summary: Fund selection used to mean reading hundred-page PDFs by hand. I designed a pipeline that pairs LLM extraction with a 7-factor scoring framework, converting each raw fund document into a 14-section workbook with a composite rating, an A/B/C/Pass shelf verdict, and a client-ready factsheet. It made the team's triage reproducible — same inputs, same verdict, documented reasoning.

sections.heading: From PDF to verdict
sections.body: LLM extraction pulls strategy, terms, track record, and risk data out of raw fund documents; a 7-factor scoring framework turns it into a 14-section due-diligence workbook with a composite rating and an A/B/C/Pass shelf verdict the IR team can defend.

sections.heading: Coverage at intern speed
sections.body: Processed ~17 fund managers across 8 alternative-asset sectors — hedge funds, private equity, real estate, VC, quant, private debt, digital assets — shipping 34 manager- and sub-fund-level tearsheets plus outbound IR emails and investment commentary.

sections.heading: The LP engine
sections.body: Rebuilt the firm's 5,146-contact LP database as v2.0: LLM-driven matching ranks every contact into Tier 1/2/3 prospect bands for each new fund, and the whole thing is queryable in natural language instead of by manual row-scanning.

sections.heading: Workflow leverage
sections.body: Shipped the supporting tools the team now runs on — automated HTML email broadcasts through Monday CRM, LLM-driven web scraping to enrich the company database, and scripted automations across recurring processes.

highlights: 14-section due-diligence workbook with composite rating and A/B/C/Pass shelf verdict
34 tearsheets across ~17 managers and 8 alternative-asset sectors
5,146-contact LP database with Tier 1/2/3 prospect matching, queryable in natural language
Outbound IR emails and investment commentary drafted alongside the analysis
Manual triage replaced with a reproducible, documented process
